cases.expectedEvidence: It may take up to 24 hours after dispatch for the first scan to appear.

cases.referenceAnswer: If tracking has not changed for three business days, contact support with the order number.
cases.expectedEvidence: How it works If tracking has not changed for three business days, contact support with the order number.

cases.question: What are the support hours?
cases.referenceAnswer: Weekdays, 9 a.m.-6 p.m. Eastern Time.
